title: Coated Abrasives - Flap Wheel with Incorporated Flanges or Separate Flanges - Designation and Dimensions
clause_1_scope: This Indian Standard (IS 15066) covers Coated Abrasives - Flap Wheel with Incorporated Flanges or Separate Flanges - Designation and Dimensions. This Indian Standard was adopted by the Sectional Committee had been approved by the Basic and Production Engineering Division Council. This standard is being prepared based on expertise available with the industry in India and the assistance has been derived from ISO 5429 : 1977 'Coated abrasives — Flap wheels with incorporated flanges or separate flanges — Designation and dimensions' issued by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO). This standard also covers requirements of sector mop wheel and cup wheel. Sector mop wheel replace wire brush operation, no danger of scoring or scratching, produces finer internal finish. Sector wheel resilient abrasive cloth segments squeeze into small openings and expand inside. This resiliency creates a mopping action that cleans, polishes all inside surfaces equally. Also used to polish the surface of metal containers. Small fast cutting resilient wheels for polish grinding intricate surfaces. Maintains perfect balance at speeds up
clause_3_terminology: Flap Wheel with Incorporated Flanges or Separate Flanges

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
